video.prompt:
[SCENE] Early autumn evening in a Japanese rice paddy right after harvest. Ankle-height close shot: a farmer wearing plain matte black knee-high rubber boots steps down from a grassy earthen levee into shallow muddy paddy water, the boot sinks a little into the soft mud, brown water ripples outward, then the second boot follows with one more step forward.
[CAMERA] Low stable tracking shot at boot height, 35mm lens, aperture f/5.6 so the rice stubble and levee behind stay clearly readable (no heavy background blur), focus on the boots. Smooth, real-time speed, no slow-motion.
[LIGHTING] Low warm golden-hour side light from camera-left, 3800K, long soft shadows, specular glints on wet mud and water.
[MATERIALS & TEXTURE] Glossy wet black rubber, sticky dark brown mud, cut rice stubble rows, dry grass on the levee.
[COLOR PALETTE] Charcoal black, deep earth brown, muted green-gold. Natural contrast.
[AUDIO] Natural sounds only: squelch of boots in mud, small water splashes, faint evening insects. No music, no voice.
[AVOID] Logos, text, letters or brand marks on the boots, extra legs, deformed feet, morphing boots, camera shake, fisheye distortion, heavy bokeh, people's faces.

images.prompt:
[SCENE] A Japanese rice paddy at golden hour in early autumn, vertical frame. In the lower half, a weathered flat wooden plank lies across a grassy earthen levee at the edge of the paddy, empty and clean, as a natural stage in the foreground. Behind it, rows of harvested rice stubble and shallow water reflecting the warm sky; distant low mountains and a few trees. Upper third: calm, tonally uniform soft evening sky within the natural scene.
[LIGHTING] Low sun from camera-right behind the scene, 3600K warm rim light, soft long shadows, subtle haze.
[LENS & CAMERA] Shot on 35mm, aperture f/8, the plank in sharp focus and the background clearly readable with only mild depth falloff.
[MATERIALS & TEXTURE] Raw grey-brown wood grain, damp dark soil, dry golden stubble, glassy paddy water.
[COLOR PALETTE] Deep charcoal shadows, warm amber light, muted green-gold, one natural deep red accent from red spider lilies.
[AVOID] Text, letters, logos, watermarks, people, animals, boots, products on the plank, oversaturated sky, heavy blur, tilted horizon.
